EmailTemplate.subject: College of Health Solutions: Get started!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
You've recently expressed interest in enrolling in one of ASU's College of Health Solutions’ graduate programs. The college anticipates and responds to demands for highly qualified health professionals as the health industry transforms. Classes are offered online, full-time and part-time, and in the evenings to meet the needs of working professionals, students moving directly into a graduate program, or people who are making career changes.
Are you considering starting a graduate program in the fall? If so, let’s work together to create a timeline to get your application submitted before the program begins. If the deadline has passed, I’d like us to connect and talk about the next start date.
Please don’t hesitate to contact me with any other questions or if you’d like some application tips.
Sincerely,
{!User.Email}
